Problem Description
: Missing converter
We could see the charger is at v4.0.11, We recommend charger to be on latest FW i.e. v6.0.3.
We could see the charger have active error flag and have F:0 and E:10
F:0 implies the Fast Shutdown - idle
E:10, implies PFC Bus Overvoltage Protection., Repair needed is No.
We suggest swapping the Converter with adjust converter and Analyse if issue persists.
If issue persists, We can consider replacing the power converter.
